purpose: Protect the future Autumn 2026 AMECO release-conditioned source cycle from the announced retirement of the old AMECO Online interface, without guessing a future release URL, refetching retained historical vintages, inspecting future values, or reopening the deferred fiscal mechanism.

future_release_discovery_protocol.prerequisite: European Commission publishes the Autumn 2026 full macroeconomic forecast / corresponding AMECO full release.
allowed_discovery_surfaces: official AMECO database page current-release links
official AMECO Archive once the vintage is published there
official ECFIN Redisstat Bulk Download Facility
required_before_value_extraction: identify the exact official Autumn 2026 release/vintage
identify the exact official machine-readable source target without filename or UUID guessing
retain exact provider bytes or exact reproducible API response
record provider URL/query, response identity, byte size and SHA-256 where byte payload applies
verify the exact UBLGBPS structural-primary target semantics and release label/date
create a new preregistered source-cycle contract before any modelling decision
dataset_identity_discovery_order: Use the official ECFIN Redisstat AMECO browser or the official ECFIN SDMX all-dataflows catalogue to identify the dataset code from provider metadata.
Cross-check the candidate dataset title/structure against the official Redisstat Catalogue TOC and dataflow/DSD metadata.
Verify that the provider metadata contains the frozen UBLGBPS semantic target before constructing any data query.
Only after dataset and target identity are provider-verified may a reproducible data query or bulk payload be retained.

semantic_migration_anchor.target_semantics: Structural balance of general government excluding interest; adjustment based on potential GDP; excessive deficit procedure; percentage of potential GDP at current prices.
semantic_migration_anchor.official_current_release_category: Cyclical Adjustment of Public Finance Variables
semantic_migration_anchor.category_link_basis: The official 3 June 2026 AMECO current-release download page links the Cyclical Adjustment of Public Finance Variables category to ameco17.zip.
semantic_migration_anchor.redisstat_api_rule: The official ECFIN Redisstat API documentation requires /data/{DATASET_CODE} and states that DATASET_CODE must be obtained from the Redisstat browser next to the dataset title.
semantic_migration_anchor.future_discovery_requirement: At or after the next full AMECO release, identify the official Redisstat dataset code from the official browser/catalogue/API metadata itself, then verify the UBLGBPS semantic target before constructing or retaining any query.
semantic_migration_anchor.redisstat_dataset_code_discovery_method: Obtain the code from official Redisstat browser/dataflow/catalogue metadata by matching provider title/structure, then verify the frozen UBLGBPS target in provider structural metadata. Do not derive the code from AMECO chapter numbering, ameco17, or third-party mirrors.

future_execution_prerequisites: official provider Redisstat dataset code is identified from provider metadata
UBLGBPS semantics are verified in provider structural metadata
a new preregistered source-cycle contract is committed
the new workflow/script is bound only to that new contract and cannot overwrite retained historical evidence
legacy_workflow_execution_boundary.rationale: The retained probe/materialisation workflows are executable reproductions of a frozen Spring-2026 legacy-ZIP contract. Treating a later rerun as a new vintage would mislabel old-source retrieval as Autumn-2026 evidence. The future Redisstat executor is intentionally deferred until the release and provider dataset identity exist.
